scripts.dev:backend: concurrently -k -n db,server,embedded -c blue,green,yellow "pnpm db" "cargo run -p alia-server" "cargo run -p alia-embedded"
scripts.web:openapi: cargo run -p alia-server --bin openapi -- clients/web/openapi/openapi.json && pnpm --dir clients/web openapi:ts
scripts.ios:build: DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild -project clients/ios/Alia.xcodeproj -scheme Alia -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -derivedDataPath clients/ios/DerivedData build
